verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a scheduling SaaS that also ships a self-hostable edition, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest items do not qualify: Cal.diy's self-hosting 'full control' claim, GDPR/CCPA compliance claims, and PostHog/Fathom analytics apps are adjacent features, not a documented opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
